notes.title: Silent Residence Releasing August 20th!
notes.content:
[p]That's right! Silent Residence will be releasing on August 20th, free to play for everyone! Embark on Harry's story of fighting schizophrenia and his delusions! Explore his apartment, both ordinary and twisted, as everyday objects morph into strange environments!

This free game is part of a larger horror universe in my world. Step inside Harry's mind, and I'll be seeing you soon.
[/p][p]Releasing August 20th.[/p]
